description: Refine WeeklyReport.tsx component: typography cleanup (remove ALL-CAPS section titles, lighter section heading weight), enlarge primary metric numbers, reformat best-day summary text to two-line format, compact the daily bar chart, restructure By Topic from chips to vertical list with progress bars, reduce card border weight. This file is fully isolated from index.tsx changes.
steps: 1. If branch 'feat/dashboard-ui-refinement' does not exist, create it from master: 'git checkout -b feat/dashboard-ui-refinement'. If it already exists, check it out.
2. Open src/components/planner/WeeklyReport.tsx. Read the FULL file before making any change.

3. Modify weekSummary() function: after the zero-tasks early returns, replace the parts[]/join logic with: if best && best.completed > 0, return 'Best day · {dayLabel}\n{count} task(s) · {fmtDuration(best.minutes)} focused' (omit duration part if best.minutes === 0). The two early-return strings ('No tasks completed yet...' and 'No tasks were completed...') remain unchanged.
4. In the header JSX, change the sectionTitle text from 'Weekly Report' to 'Weekly report'. Change its inline color from tokens.textMuted to tokens.textSecondary.
5. In the stats row JSX: change statLabel text 'Tasks Done' -> 'Tasks completed'; change statLabel text 'Time Spent' -> 'Time focused'. Keep all icons, trend rows, and calculations unchanged.

6. In the Daily Breakdown chart section: change chartTitle text 'Daily Breakdown' -> 'Daily activity'. Change its inline color from tokens.textMuted to tokens.textSecondary. Change barH calculation max from 88 to 46: 'Math.max(4, Math.round((day.completed / maxCompleted) * 46))'. Add a conditional empty state: if all days have completed===0, show a centered View with Text 'No activity this week' instead of the barsContainer.

7. In the By Topic section: change chartTitle text 'By Topic' -> 'By topic'. Change its inline color from tokens.textMuted to tokens.textSecondary. Remove the topicList/topicChip JSX entirely. Replace with a vertical list: compute maxCount = max of all topic counts, then map sorted topics to rows each containing: (a) a header row with dot + name (flex:1, numberOfLines=1) + count text, (b) a bar track with a fill sized to (count/maxCount)*100%  using the topic color.

8. In makeStyles(tokens): (a) sectionTitle: remove textTransform:'uppercase', change fontWeight '700'->'600', change letterSpacing 0.8->0.3, change fontSize 12->13. (b) statValue: change fontSize 18->22, add lineHeight:28. (c) statLabel: change fontSize 10->11. (d) summary: remove fontStyle:'italic', change lineHeight 18->22. (e) chartTitle: change fontSize 11->12, add fontWeight:'500', change marginBottom 10->8. (f) barsContainer: change height 96->72. (g) card: change borderWidth 1->StyleSheet.hairlineWidth.

9. In makeStyles(tokens): add new style keys: barEmptyState (height:72, alignItems:'center', justifyContent:'center'), barEmptyText (fontSize:12, lineHeight:18), topicBarList (gap:10), topicBarRow (gap:4), topicBarHeader (flexDirection:'row', alignItems:'center', gap:6), topicBarName (fontSize:12, flex:1, lineHeight:18), topicBarCount (fontSize:12, fontWeight:'600', flexShrink:0, lineHeight:18), topicBarTrack (height:4, borderRadius:99, overflow:'hidden'), topicBarFill (height:'100%', borderRadius:99).
10. Remove now-unused style keys from makeStyles: topicList, topicChip, topicName, topicCount.
11. Run 'npx tsc --noEmit' from the workspace root /Users/parteek.kumar/Dev/common-tasks/daily-planner. Fix any TypeScript errors before proceeding.
12. Run 'npx vitest --run' from the workspace root. All tests must pass.

13. Stage the changed file: 'git add src/components/planner/WeeklyReport.tsx'. Commit: 'git commit -m "refactor(dashboard): refine WeeklyReport typography, metrics, chart, topic bars"'. Record commit hash in findings.
acceptance_criteria: 'Weekly report' heading in sentence case (not 'WEEKLY REPORT' uppercase)
sectionTitle style has no textTransform:'uppercase' property
weekSummary() returns two-line 'Best day · {day}\n{tasks} · {time} focused' format when there is a best day
chartTitle texts read 'Daily activity' and 'By topic' (sentence case)
bar chart barsContainer height is 72, max bar height is 46
When all daily completions are 0, 'No activity this week' empty state is shown instead of empty bars
By topic section shows vertical rows with name + count + full-width colored progress bar (no chips)
npx tsc --noEmit exits with zero errors
npx vitest --run passes all existing tests
findings: Implemented all 10 steps. Commit: 9eb5618 on branch feat/dashboard-ui-refinement. WeeklyReport.tsx introduces zero new TypeScript errors (9 pre-existing errors in other files are unchanged). All 18 vitest tests pass.
